content: Side-by-Side Pricing Plans: Design Ideas for Pricing Page Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000076998 Designing Side-By-Side Pricing Table Pages: Text and Images can be added inside the Text Editor and the content will appear on the Join Page: Additional Information: » Everything About WYSIWYG Editors » How to Post Images On WYSIWYG Editors Outcome: 2) Use the Hero Section: » How to add a Hero Section to Static pages Outcome: 3) Showcase one of the plans: To emphasize one of the plans in your Pricing Plan Menu go to the Toolbox > Menu Manager > Side by Side Pricing Menu > Edit: Look for the plan that will be showcased, click on Settings, and in the Outer <li> CSS Class add " showcase " next to the class that is already in place. For additional questions or help setting this up, please submit a ticket to support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket HERE .
